tasks.label: Build Chrome Extensions
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Copy-Item tooltip.js automatic/; Copy-Item docs-tooltip.js automatic/; Copy-Item tooltip.js manual/; Copy-Item docs-tooltip.js manual/; Compress-Archive -Path automatic/manifest.json,automatic/content_script.js,automatic/tooltip.js,automatic/docs-tooltip.js,automatic/popup.html,automatic/popup.js,automatic/background.js,translate.js,mappings,shift16.png,shift32.png,shift48.png,shift128.png -DestinationPath extension.zip -Force; Compress-Archive -Path manual/manifest.json,manual/tooltip.js,manual/docs-tooltip.js,manual/popup.html,manual/popup.js,manual/background.js,translate.js,mappings,shift16.png,shift32.png,shift48.png,shift128.png -DestinationPath extension_manual.zip -Force; Remove-Item automatic/tooltip.js; Remove-Item automatic/docs-tooltip.js; Remove-Item manual/tooltip.js; Remove-Item manual/docs-tooltip.js"
